entries.title: Job 12:1
segments: ¶And Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 12:2
segments: No doubt but ye [are] the people, and wisdom shall die with you.

entries.title: Job 12:3
segments: But I have understanding as well as you; I [am] not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these? {understanding: Heb. an heart} {I am...: Heb. I fall not lower than you} {who...: Heb. with whom are not such as these?}

words.text: as well as you; I [am] not inferior
to you: yea, who knoweth not such things
as these? {understanding: Heb. an heart} {I am...: Heb. I fall not lower than you} {who...: Heb. with whom are not such as these?}

entries.title: Job 12:4
segments: I am [as] one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright [man is] laughed to scorn.

entries.title: Job 12:5
segments: He that is ready to slip with [his] feet [is as] a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.

words.text: of him that is at ease

entries.title: Job 12:6
segments: ¶The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth [abundantly].

entries.title: Job 12:7
segments: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:

entries.title: Job 12:8
segments: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.

entries.title: Job 12:9
segments: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?

words.text: not in all these that the hand

entries.title: Job 12:10
segments: In whose hand [is] the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind. {soul: or, life} {all...: Heb. all flesh of man}

words.text: . {soul: or, life} {all...: Heb. all flesh of man}

entries.title: Job 12:11
segments: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat? {mouth: Heb. palate}

entries.title: Job 12:12
segments: ¶With the ancient [is] wisdom; and in length of days understanding.

entries.title: Job 12:13
segments: With him [is] wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding. {With...: that is, With God}

entries.title: Job 12:14
segments: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening. {up: Heb. upon}

words.text: , and it cannot be built again
, and there can be no opening

entries.title: Job 12:15
segments: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

entries.title: Job 12:16
segments: With him [is] strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver [are] his.

entries.title: Job 12:17
segments: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.

entries.title: Job 12:18
segments: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.

entries.title: Job 12:19
segments: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.

entries.title: Job 12:20
segments: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged. {speech...: Heb. lip of the faithful}

entries.title: Job 12:21
segments: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty. {weakeneth...: or, looseth the girdle of the strong}

words.text: . {weakeneth...: or, looseth the girdle of the strong}

entries.title: Job 12:22
segments: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

entries.title: Job 12:23
segments: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them [again]. {straiteneth: Heb. leadeth in}

entries.title: Job 12:24
segments: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness [where there is] no way.

entries.title: Job 12:25
segments: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like [a] drunken [man]. {stagger: Heb. wander}

words.text: , and he maketh them to stagger
